mentions.name: halalcodecheck.com
mentions.description: A platform for verifying food ingredients. It started as a tool to scan or upload product labels to check ingredients and has grown into a repository of brands, food types, and guides covering major accreditation bodies in the US, UK, Canada and elsewhere. Recent work includes a seasonal gifting vertical as a new revenue surface, audits of verdicts for all brands and food items using data from authentic sources and official accreditation bodies, expanded programmatic SEO across ingredient and brand categories, and turning zero-result dead-ends into a list growth lever.
